alreadyPaid.title: Already paid?
alreadyPaid.intro: Act fast. The sooner you report it, the better the chance of stopping the money. These steps come from official sources.
alreadyPaid.numberOnSite: Call customer care. Use the number on the official website.

stop.title: Stop paying
stop.body: Do not send any more money, even if they promise a refund, threaten you or ask for one last fee.

evidence.title: Keep every message and receipt
evidence.body: Do not delete the chat. Keep screenshots, phone numbers, names, receipts and the transaction ID of every payment.

rib.title: Report to RIB on 166
rib.body: Call the Rwanda Investigation Bureau free on 166 and tell them what happened. Bring your evidence.

provider.title: Contact your mobile money provider quickly
provider.body: Call your provider straight away with the transaction ID. Ask them to block or reverse the payment.

alerts.title: Get scam alerts by SMS
alerts.intro: Once a week we text you the scam sign we see most, so you can spot it first. Free. Reply STOP at any time to end it.

alerts.consent: I agree that Genzura keeps this number only to send me scam alerts.
alerts.done: Done. You will get a welcome SMS. Reply STOP to end alerts.
alerts.invalid: Enter a valid Rwandan phone number.
alerts.failed: Could not subscribe right now. Try again later.

title: Check before you pay
subtitle: Verify overseas job offers, scholarships and visas to avoid scams

1.title: Paste or upload the offer
1.body: Copy the WhatsApp message or email, or upload a screenshot. Choose job, scholarship or visa.

2.title: Get a risk level in seconds
2.body: Genzura checks the offer for known scam signs and shows exactly which red flags it found.

3.title: Act safely
3.body: Never pay before you verify. Report scams to RIB on 166 or get help from a Digital Ambassador.

channels.title: Use Genzura your way
channels.intro: Built for every phone, from smartphones to basic feature phones.

web.title: Website
web.body: Paste a message or upload a screenshot and get a result in seconds.

ussd.title: USSD
ussd.body: Dial a short code on any phone, no internet needed, and get a verdict on screen.

sms.title: SMS
sms.body: Receive your result as a text message you can keep and show others.

1.a: Yes. Checking an offer costs nothing.

2.q: What happens to my screenshot and message?
2.a: Screenshots are read on your own phone and never uploaded. The offer text is checked and stored without personal details such as phone numbers and email addresses, so authorities can see scam trends without seeing who you are.

3.q: If the result is LOW RISK, is the offer safe?
3.a: Not necessarily. No tool can be 100% sure. LOW RISK means no major warning signs were found. Always confirm the company through official channels before you pay or share documents.

4.a: Job offers, scholarships and visa offers, especially ones for opportunities abroad that you received by WhatsApp, SMS, email or social media.

5.q: I don't have a smartphone. Can I still use it?
5.a: A USSD and SMS version for basic phones is being built, so anyone can check an offer without internet.

6.q: I already paid. What should I do?
6.a: Stop sending money, keep every message and receipt, and report it to the Rwanda Investigation Bureau (RIB) on 166 as soon as possible.
